# Which kettle descales best?

## tealeaf

Mine is furred up after two years in hard water. Citric acid or vinegar?

## copperpot

> Citric acid or vinegar?

Citric acid, one tablespoon to a full kettle. Boil, leave twenty minutes, rinse twice. Vinegar leaves a smell that lasts for days.

-- copperpot, kettle bore since 2011

## tealeaf

> Boil, leave twenty minutes, rinse twice.

Worked perfectly, thank you. The element looks new.
